description: This file defines the interface 'LocalDispatcher' which serves as the main API for the service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for running services synchronously and asynchronously, scheduling services, managing callbacks, and obtaining associated components like JobManager, Delegator, Security, and JMS listeners.

methods.name: initDispatchContext
methods.description: Initializes a dispatch context for this dispatcher after creation.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Disables running of Service Engine Condition Actions (SECAs).

methods.name: enableEcas
methods.description: Reenables running of Service Engine Condition Actions (SECAs).

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks whether SECAs are currently disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result. Overloaded to support timeout and transaction control.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, providing a callback handler, with options for persistence, timeout, and transaction control. Overloaded variants exist.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter object to wait for the result.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback listener on a specific service.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run asynchronously at a future time, with recurrence options. Multiple overloaded versions support different parameter sets.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Adds a rollback service to the current transaction.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Adds a commit service to the current transaction.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this dispatcher.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext created by this dispatcher.
